adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over each destination and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` (packages/core/EventManager.ts). However, `Office365CalendarService.createEvent` always uses only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const eventsUrl = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? ...`) and has no logic to select the destination calendar matching the current credential being used. This means when multiple destination calendars are present (e.g., collective hosts appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` in handleNewBooking), every Office365 credential will still attempt to write to `destinationCalendar[0]` regardless of which credential/token is used, plausibly causing failures or writes to the wrong calendar.
